description: This file defines a declarative configuration structure for Kubernetes PodAffinity, including methods for building and chaining configuration options related to pod affinity scheduling rules.

classes.name: PodAffinityApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing a declarative configuration of the PodAffinity type, including required and preferred scheduling rules.

methods.name: PodAffinity
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of PodAffinityApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithRequiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution
methods.description: Method to append PodAffinityTerm configurations to the RequiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution field, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: WithPreferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution
methods.description: Method to append WeightedPodAffinityTerm configurations to the PreferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution field, supporting method chaining.
